items.docs: This API fetches the agent availability setting configured in your help desk portal.
This API updates the agent availability setting configured in your help desk portal.

params.name: include
params.description: Key that includes additional, channel-specific information. Values allowed are: mailStatus, phoneStatus, phoneMode, chatStatus, and presenceStatus

params.name: departmentId
params.description: ID of the department from which the availability details should be fetched. To include all accessible departments, pass the value of this key as @-1@.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of agents to list. The default value is 20 and the maximum value allowed is 6000.

items.docs: This API lists the agents who are currently offline in a particular department.
